scientific_integrity: Direct analytic global minimization and strict uniqueness certificate; finite exact and numerical reproduction tests are supplementary. Publication priority is a best-knowledge assessment; independent audit and independent validation have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge complete graphs; real positive independent linear gain prices; all controls continuous and nonnegative. No claim for graph constraints, nonlinear device costs, individual gain caps, directed dynamics or arbitrary graph topologies. Prior weighted-cost SDP formulations and equal-cost pinning results are excluded from novelty claims.
title: Price-sorted activation and exact spectral rates for pinned complete networks
